verdict.rationale: Empresa Online is a company-formation service, and a buyer comparing formation services could fairly ask about user-configurable background automations such as recurring compliance tasks, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes a guided, human-driven flow: form entry, digital signatures by every partner, manual payment within 48 hours, and email notifications. The automatic generation of the articles of association (pacto social) is a built-in step, not an automation the user sets up. Nothing shows user-defined automations, scheduling or autonomous background execution.
